_comment: Synthesized from real planner output observed in Trekoon and Gitlab-Issues-Creator repo trace logs (intent_planner_error >= 60 by 2026-05-12). The planner selected seqs 5017+5018 and deferred 5019, then emitted a deferred_reasons entry referencing seq 5018 (which is selected, not deferred). Today this trips ValidateIntentPlan with 'deferred reason references non-deferred seq 5018' and the daemon falls back to the deterministic one-item provider for the entire window.
